questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

D _ P _ U D N _ T _ _ _ P T U D _ _ T U
questions.solution:
Given series: D _ P _ U D N _ T _ _ _ P T U D _ _ T U

Option 1) TNUPDNNP → D __T__ P __N__ U D N __U__ T **__P__** __D__ __N__ P T U D __N__ __P__ T U → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) NTUPNDPN → D __N__ P __T__ U D N __U__ T __P__ __N__ __D__ P T U D __P__ __N__ T U → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) TNPUNDPN → D __T__ P __N__ U D N __P__ T __U__ __N__ __D__ P T U D __P__ __N__ T U → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) NTPUDNNP → D __**N**__ P __**T**__ U D N __**P**__ T __**U**__ __**D**__ __**N**__ P T U D __**N**__ __**P**__ T U → (It follows the pattern of: DNPTU - DNPTU - DNPTU - DNPTU)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six persons U, V, W, X, Y, Z are sitting in a circle facing each other. V is between X and W. U is between Y and W. Z is to the immediate right of X. Who is the immediate neighbour of both U and Z?
questions.solution:
Given: Six persons U, V, W, X, Y, Z are sitting in a circle facing each other. 

1) Z is to the immediate right of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f792d2a8cd733d762d59c6eb0909b9533b808fc3f2a6bc40b495b52a9f3219e.png] 

2) V is between X and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0f26cb78d6d7de1c1305ebce941dac23d8335e554bf31e7e9ed00b8e4aa2bf8.png] 

3) U is between Y and W. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b98d40fd349e50244e85f58d976af130d77de995b65f63e4b2088cbfa7b3bb0d.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Y is an immediate neighbour of both U and Z.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Baskets are Cakes.

Some Cakes are Tarts.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Cakes are Baskets.

II. Some Tarts are Cakes.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba6c8edb8472b3609073a8373cf2f38180099bb124386ac5f4e8eaceb89accc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Cakes are Baskets → Follow (As some Baskets are Cakes. As some part of baskets is common with cakes, therefore it is true.)

II. Some Tarts are Cakes → Follow (As some Cakes are Tarts. As some part of cakes is common with tarts, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
